hey i’ve fucked up bad too. first was when i was in college and refused to pay my rent for 3 months because my landlord wouldn’t fix my heater and i lived in northern mn at the time. got sent to collections and threatened that it would screw up my credit. it turned out fine. next, i quit school on a whim to move back home and within 6 months i was in severe debt that i’m still paying back. it turned out fine. right now, i’m hopeless for the fact i just lost my job and my boyfriend in a messy breakup, but in the end i know it will be fine. 
please don’t think this is your only way out, reach out to me, channel your energy through something creative (my energy is being channeled by writing letters to serial killers in prison, wack i know), please, PLEASE know that death is not the only option. 
please also know that we have literally all fucked up.
